# What will your Datadog bill be, and what cuts it most?

> Estimate a monthly Datadog bill from your own usage (hosts, containers, custom metrics, logs, APM, synthetics) at editable list prices, and see which changes cut it most, with a dollar saving for each. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [How to reduce your Datadog bill: levers ranked by dollar impact](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/datadog-bill-estimator/how-to-reduce-your-datadog-bill.html)
